scope: Authored EPS raster TTL and ownership lifecycle through existing cache/swap
policy: Deterministic TTL zero avoids sleeps. Expired visible frame cannot be leased by new consumers but its visible pin protects resident storage; unpin permits expiry spill
ownership: External DecodedRaster clone retains 64 pixel bytes after RAM membership disappears and swap write completes; releasing last external owner frees credit
restore: Changing policy to TTL none permits background restoration from unchanged swap object; every RGBA byte matches analytic EPS red/blue raster
scope_limits: Selected authored EPS subset. No EPS production viewer routing, prefetch, disk-TTL, arbitrary positive TTL timing, CUDA/NVIDIA or physical HDR proof
remaining: Prefetch/viewer integration and source identity, broader EPS qualification, strict color and raster edge gates, measured throughput
